contracts.commit_point: Runner.run_sync(NBA_AGENT, prompt, session=session) at python/opentelemetry-llm-demo/app/agent_service.py line 48 — the point at which the guarded agent turn (outbound model API request) would commit; a tripped guardrail aborts before/during this call and commits instead as an HTTP 400 from the handler at main.py lines 20-32.
contracts.declared_mechanism: nba_content_guardrail, declared with the @input_guardrail() decorator (guardrails.py lines 4-9) and registered on NBA_AGENT via input_guardrails=[nba_content_guardrail] (agent_service.py line 20); it keyword-scans the run input and trips for off-topic queries. The raised InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered is converted by the FastAPI exception handler @app.exception_handler(InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered), which records the exception on the current span and returns JSONResponse(status_code=400) with the guardrail output_info (main.py lines 20-32).
contracts.forbidden_condition: The guardrail input for the run — the latest user-role message when input_data is a list, or the raw string otherwise — lowercased, with length >= 5, contains none of the configured NBA/basketball keywords (guardrails.py lines 12-34, 49-52), causing nba_content_guardrail to return GuardrailFunctionOutput(tripwire_triggered=True) and abort the run with InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered.

contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the NBA_Reporter agent turn: run_agent_turn composing the turn prompt and invoking Runner.run_sync(NBA_AGENT, prompt, session=session), which issues model API requests (and may drive WebSearchTool) during the agent run.
contracts.protected_resource: NBA_AGENT (OpenAI Agents SDK agent named "NBA_Reporter", backed by OPENAI_MODEL with WebSearchTool and calculate_win_percentage) and its guarded LLM turn reached via the POST /agent/turn endpoint.
contracts.protection_obligation: Off-topic (non-NBA/basketball) user input must be blocked by the registered input guardrail on NBA_AGENT before the agent's LLM turn executes at Runner.run_sync, with the tripwire surfaced as an HTTP 400 response instead of an agent/web-search run.
scope_limits: The guardrail is a keyword substring heuristic: inputs shorter than 5 characters always pass (guardrails.py lines 52-53), and off-topic text containing any listed keyword (e.g., 'game', 'score', 'report', 'news') passes; it is not a semantic topical classifier.

The guardrail screens agent-run input only; it does not inspect tool results or the agent's final message (sanitize_agent_message at agent_service.py line 50 is output formatting, not topical screening).
The separate _validate_topic HTTPException (agent_service.py lines 25-34) is ordinary application-level topic validation and is outside this contract.
Blocking is established only for the FastAPI request path; handling of InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered in other runtimes or entry points is not established.

The contract asserts the guardrail gates the run-level agent turn; whether a tripwire aborts already-started WebSearchTool or model effects (versus preventing their start) is not established from supplied source.
